question: For an interactive robotic lamp with the proposed AHM-emotion integration, how does the combined modeled transport delay/drop profile (C1) versus ideal delivery (C0) change timely motion-plus-RGB responses, state transitions, and fault ticks under matched stimuli? The completed 22 s fixed-FSM offline trials are only preliminary evidence.
hypothesis: Compared with ideal C0, C1 will reduce the share of expected interactions achieving both simulated motion and RGB onset within 1.0 s and increase state transitions/fault ticks because delayed, dropped or out-of-order input samples can interrupt recognition and recovery. This is a hypothesis for the planned integrated study, not proof that delay or drop alone causes each effect.
biological_inspiration_source: Artificial hormone signaling: a stimulus affects hormone production; concentration accumulates and decays through clearance/binding and is read through a receptor, creating a slower internal state (Lab04 README, referring to Homchanthanakul et al. 2019, DOI 10.1109/IROS40897.2019.8968580). Rhythmic neural oscillation motivates the SO(2) CPG from Lab03 README citing lec5.pptx slide 18. The exact Euler rates and robotic mappings are proposed course models, not experimental constants from the paper.
AHM_equation: One normalized hormone H: R_old=clamp((H_old-H_min)/(H_max-H_min),0,1); P=k_prod*S, C=k_clear*H_old, B=k_bind*R_old; H_new=clamp(H_old+dt*(P-C-B),0,1); R_new=clamp((H_new-H_min)/(H_max-H_min),0,1). Source: Lab04 README, proposed-course Euler implementation drawing on hormone mechanisms referenced to Homchanthanakul et al. (2019).
SO2_CPG_equation: Lab03 SO(2) CPG, citing Dr. Poramate course lec5.pptx slide 18: a1(t+1)=alpha*(cos(phi)*o1(t)+sin(phi)*o2(t)); a2(t+1)=alpha*(-sin(phi)*o1(t)+cos(phi)*o2(t)); o1(t+1)=tanh(a1(t+1)); o2(t+1)=tanh(a2(t+1)). Update both outputs simultaneously from the previous-step values. CPG rhythmic motion is planned, not integrated into the completed Lab07 run.
integration_description: Proposed AHM-emotion integration: use receptor R_new to scale expressive FSM poses only in interested/happy: g(R)=0.5+0.5*R, q_cmd=clamp(g(R)*q_FSM, -q_limit,+q_limit), q=[tilt,extend,nod] rad, q_limit=[0.35,0.25,0.30] rad. Preserve afraid/fault safety and actuator slew limiting. Use a bounded sample/hold connection from AHM dt 0.05 s to FSM dt 0.02 s. SO(2) CPG remains a separate planned rhythmic module. None of this integration was implemented or tested in the preliminary fixed-FSM trials.
independent_variable: Two-level combined transport PROFILE, not separate delay and drop factors: C0 ideal model delay=0/drop=0; C1 random delays from 0 to 0.18 s plus drop probability 0.08 and burst loss at 12.50-12.70 s in the 22 s preliminary simulation. Other policy and stimuli settings matched. C1 cannot isolate the individual effects of delay versus loss.

conditions.name: C0
conditions.change: Ideal modeled delivery (zero added delay and zero modeled drop); real-robot baseline means no intentionally added network impairment, not physically zero latency; 3 paired repeats per platform planned.

conditions.name: C1
conditions.change: Combined modeled random delay (choices 0,0.02,0.04,0.06,0.10,0.14,0.18 s), independent random drop probability 0.08 plus scheduled burst drop 12.50-12.70 s for preliminary 22 s test; a bounded, safety-reviewed impairment profile will be separately specified for planned 600 s/hardware trials.

metrics.name: primary_both_response_pass_rate
metrics.measurement: From input source_time_s to max(first applied motion onset, first applied RGB onset) in offline traces. Pass if both are observed and latency <=1.0 s; report 7 input IDs per 22 s preliminary trial, summed across 3 matched seeds.
metrics.missing_rule: If either onset does not occur before the trial ends, record null/N/A and count as a miss in the expected-input denominator. An observed latency >1.0 s is a deadline failure, not a missing observation. Real robot requires measured physical onsets.

metrics.name: state_transition_count
metrics.measurement: Count emotion differences between consecutive command_trace.csv ticks (1100 tick-to-tick intervals in a 22 s trial). Compare matched C0/C1 trials, interpreting change count together with correctness.
metrics.missing_rule: If command trace or state sequence is incomplete, report N/A with the trace-integrity problem, not zero.

metrics.name: fault_tick_count
metrics.measurement: Count controller ticks with invalid or stale input channels in command_trace.csv; 1101 total ticks for a completed 22 s trial. Shared invalid/stale probes are present in both conditions.
metrics.missing_rule: Report N/A if tick or fault flags are unavailable; separate planned fault probes from transport-induced freshness failures.

metrics.name: both_response_latency_s
metrics.measurement: For observed responses, max(first_motion_s,first_rgb_s)-source_time_s. Preliminary offline time is virtual; physical motion onset and LED onset will be measured with encoder/camera and photodiode in a future calibrated trial.
metrics.missing_rule: Null/N/A if one or both onset timestamps are absent; never impute zero. Preserve the original source event in the denominator.

controls: Keep identical, prechecked FSM policy/version, safety guard, debounce 0.06 s, hysteresis, bounds and scheduler delay 0.04 s across C0 and C1.
Pair synthetic source stimuli by seeds 41, 42, 43 with identical initial normal state, dt 0.02 s, and duration 22 s in preliminary trials; re-declare stimuli for planned 600 s trials before running.
For future integrated trials keep the AHM parameters and AHM-emotion mapping, initialization, sensor/servo calibration, robot setup, and measurement instruments fixed across conditions.
For future human trials use the same 600 s interaction schedule, consent protocol, distance safety envelope, and stop conditions; counterbalance condition order.

parameters.name: servo_semantic_bounds
parameters.provenance: Lab07 interface_contract.json proposed semantic bounds; requires hardware calibration

parameters.name: proposed_hardware_watchdog_timeout
parameters.provenance: Student proposed safety design; not yet validated with physical robot

simulation_plan: Preliminary COMPLETED: Python standard-library, single-process virtual transport, fixed FSM, C0/C1 with paired seeds 41-43, 3 repeats/condition, 22 s/trial; raw input_trace.csv, command_trace.csv, events.csv, metrics.json, config.json, summary.json, source_snapshot and SHA256 manifest at results/completed_01. PLANNED next: implement AHM-emotion with explicit multirate update, check contract and run a 600 s synthetic human scenario with >=3 paired repeats per condition, preserving predeclared expected IDs/misses. Offline is not a ROS/DDS performance benchmark.
real_robot_plan: PLANNED, not performed: Ubuntu 24.04/ROS2 Jazzy bridge with 7 contracted /lamp topics, ESP32 sensor MCU via micro-ROS client and Agent, calibrated servo/RGB driver, verified physical safe pose and independent emergency stop. Test each condition >=3 trials with consented participant IDs P01-P03 and 600 s per human interaction scenario only after risk review; calibrate distance, button/touch, semantic joint mapping, limits, slew, and LED output. Observe physical motion with camera/encoder and RGB onset with photodiode. No physical results are claimed.
clock_correlation_plan: Seven ROS std_msgs messages have no Header; use sidecar logs with source IDs, MCU acquisition timestamps, host node/phase/local sequence, perf_counter_ns receipt/decision/publish boundaries, and explicit MCU-to-host clock offset/drift estimation with an uncertainty/error bound. Correlate IDs before subtraction and sync measurement of camera/encoder and photodiode; leave source-to-physical latency N/A until correlation and physical instrumentation are validated.
safety_stop_plan: Before human trials verify mechanically safe limits, emergency stop independent of the impaired network, low-motion startup and operator oversight. Proposed unvalidated 0.20 s hardware watchdog and loss-of-command neutral/failsafe procedure require bench validation. Stop on unexpected motion, collision risk, sensor invalid/stale values, loss of communications, or participant request. Reassess any artificial network impairment so it cannot disable safety stop.
order_counterbalancing: For PLANNED integrated/human trials, alternate pair order: pair1 C0->C1, pair2 C1->C0, pair3 C0->C1, and reset initial states and fixtures each trial. The already completed 22 s offline runner executed C0 then C1 for each seed; it was not order-counterbalanced.
paired_seed_or_participant_plan: Completed preliminary offline trials used matched synthetic seeds 41,42,43 and the same source schedule across conditions. Planned simulation: >=3 paired seed runs for each condition under a 600 s protocol. Planned real robot: >=3 condition-matched trials with consented anonymized participants P01-P03 (illustrative IDs, not enrolled participants); document consent, withdrawal, and actual assignment.
expected_input_ids_before_run: Predeclared 22 s baseline expected response subset (7 IDs): button_01,touch_01,approach_01,clear_01,near_01,clear_02,button_02. Retain all 10 source inputs including conflict and invalid/stale probes, with null/N/A for absent onsets; no post-hoc selection. A new fixed set and denominator must be declared before each planned 600 s scenario; do not reuse 7 automatically.
timeline: Completed before this project schedule: the Lab06 policy check and the Lab07 fixed-FSM 22 s offline C0/C1 runs and fault/missing analysis. Planned Week 1: prepare the proposal and implement AHM-emotion and verify CPG equations. Week 2: integrate ROS 2 and micro-ROS, calibrate and run the paired 600 s simulation. Week 3: run the paired 600 s real-robot scenarios after calibration, safety verification, and participant consent. Week 4: audit traces, clock errors and missing responses, and report. Run at least three repeats per condition on each platform. Assign roles before implementation. Week numbers are relative planning estimates, and the course announcement determines the submission deadline.
